topic: Eustass Kid's refusal to ever back down is the exact same trait that let him help beat Kaido and Big Mom at Onigashima, and the exact trait that destroyed his crew and treasure against Shanks at Elbaph
title: Eustass Kid's Pride Beat Kaido, Then Cost Him Everything
description:
Kaidou threw Eustass Kid in Udon's Prisoner Mine specifically to break his spirit. It never worked. This is the chapter-cited case that Kid's one unbreakable trait, refusing to ever kneel, is exactly what let him help take down two Emperors at Onigashima, and exactly what wiped out his crew and treasure against Shanks at Elbaph.

From Apoo's betrayal to the waterfall race with Luffy and Law, this traces the one trait that explains every win and every loss Eustass Kid has ever had.
comment: Was Eustass Kid's refusal to ever back down his greatest strength, or the exact flaw that was always going to destroy him?
